name: ascend950_vector_instruction_types
scope: A5 DAV_3510 pure-vector theoretical performance evaluation
provenance_notes: Instruction performance is sourced from asc-devkit for the explicitly listed documented_performance_dtypes or documented_performance_pairs only. supported_dtypes_source describes API type support, not guaranteed native throughput for every supported type.

The asc-devkit performance table gives single-instruction elements/cycle. throughput_cycles = 256 / dtype_width_bytes / documented_elements_per_cycle; conversion width uses max(src,dst). issue_slots is taken separately from the instruction single/dual-issue table.
Execution-unit grouping, mixed-instruction overlap, unlisted dtypes and special modes are modeling assumptions or microbenchmark calibrations, not additional asc-devkit hardware guarantees.
The independently transcribed 300 documented combinations are checked by tests/offline/test_public_instruction_rates.py using fixtures/asc_devkit_instruction_rates.csv.

units.issue_slots: issue resources per cycle: 2 for VALU-only (dual-issue) instructions, 1 for instructions needing the single non-replicated VECTOR engine
